mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of months with PAYEMS growth above 100k (annualized) and Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 3 months) or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by > 0.5% MoM, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the short term due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of months during FEDFUNDS rising periods (FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25pp in 3 months) or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of months with INDPRO growth above 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals potential central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3pp in 3 months) or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a severe demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of months where both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by > 0.5% MoM (HOUST) and > 0.2% QoQ (GDPC1), or the interaction effect is not significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rise in unemployment rate (indicating labor market deterioration) signals reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE rises by > 0.1pp, or the Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.
